soldier: Soldier: head, labrum, antennae and pronotum all yellow, the antennal carinae and fontanelle tube brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the base yellowish brown. The sides of the fontanelle with two bristles each, in a few specimens only one on one side; one bristle between the fontanelle and the antennal socket, or absent; the head with very few bristles, the margin of the pronotum with a few sparse ones and the disc with several scattered ones, the abdominal tergites with rather dense long bristles arranged in a row along the posterior margin. In dorsal view a distinct long white band runs along the midline from the posterior half of the pronotum to the end of the abdominal tergites. Head oval, narrow in front and broad behind, widest at the posterior third, the two posterolateral angles and the posterior margin slightly rounded out. Mandibles stout and rather short and straight, their tips slightly curved; labrum longer than wide, its anterior contracted part rather short, almost reaching the middle of the mandibles when closed; the aperture not visible in dorsal view, the fontanelle aperture triangular, narrow in front and broad behind. Antennae with 15 segments, the third and fourth almost equal and the third slightly smaller. The waist of the postmentum clearly lies at the posterior end. The anterior margin of the pronotum rather straight or forming an indistinct shallow concavity, the posterior margin slightly concave.
